description:
FILED s516b (Opus 5.5, 2026-10-12): after #3240 (Type::Tiny.pm loads) and #3280 (SUPER::isa(@_) flattens), `use Types::Standard -all` stops at the next blocker.

REPRODUCER (perl 5.40.3 vs the s516b tree):

    require B;
    print B::perlstring("a\"b\$c\n\x{263a}"), "\n";

perl: "a\"b\$c\n\x{263a}" (a double-quoted perl literal).  PCL: dies `Can't locate B.pm in @INC (the module is XS and has no PCL build -- see tools/pcl-xs-install)`.

REACH: Type-Tiny-2.010001 lib/Type/Tiny.pm uses B at 484, 610, 1012-1051, 1128, 1589 (`B::svref_2object(...)->XSUB`), 1624, 1633, and B::Deparse at 943; probe: scratch/s516b/pr/tt2.pl in the s516b worktree (`require Type::Tiny; require Types::Standard; Types::Standard->import('-all')` with Type-Tiny + Exporter-Tiny lib dirs on @INC).  Also the most common B use on CPAN generally (perlstring / cstring for code generation, svref_2object for sub names and flags).

FIX LAYER (rule 9a): a `lib/B.pm` shim -- B is core, its pure-perl-expressible parts are perlstring / cstring (string escapers) and a narrow svref_2object (->GV->NAME, ->STASH->NAME, ->XSUB, ->FLAGS for the number-vs-string idiom) answered from runtime facts.  Size it first: list which B:: entry points the board + Type-Tiny + Moo/Sub-Quote reach (grep -a the four populations), shim those, and let the rest die naming the entry point (rule 12).  Not attempted in s516b (a design item, not a filler).
subject: core `B` has no PCL shim: `require B; B::perlstring($s)` dies "Can't locate B.pm (the module is XS and has no PCL build)" -- the third Type::Tiny load blocker (Types::Standard reaches Type/Tiny.pm's `require B` while loading; 14 B:: call sites in Type/Tiny.pm, mostly perlstring)
